description: Elapsed bare month-day dates that fall before the previous edition ended belong to that past edition, not the upcoming one. A retrospective posted between editions recounts the past edition's dealer window; extracting it would date the 2027 edition with the 2026 edition's timeline. The prompt's lower bound (previousEditionEnd) must suppress both slots.

posts.text: Looking back at this year's dealers den: applications opened on January 5th and closed on February 1st, and we filled every table. Watch this space for next year's timeline!

_comment: expect_absent entries name a slot (event_id, category, kind). With a date, that slot must not carry that date; without a date, the slot must be absent entirely. Both elapsed occurrences (2026-01-05 and 2026-02-01) precede exampcon-2027's previousEditionEnd (2026-02-09), so they describe the 2026 edition and set nothing for 2027.

expect_absent.reason: elapsed January 5th resolves to 2026-01-05, before the previous edition ended (2026-02-09) — it recounts the 2026 edition's window
elapsed February 1st resolves to 2026-02-01, before the previous edition ended (2026-02-09) — it recounts the 2026 edition's window
